description:
The Cancer iChart Archive app is open on the Welcome screen. Your task:
1. Tap 'Search For Drug Interactions'.
2. On the Cancer Drugs list, find and select 'Crizotinib' (use the A-Z index to jump to 'C').
3. Tap 'Next' to proceed to Co-medications.
4. On the Co-medications list, select TWO medications: 'Warfarin' (scroll to W or use A-Z index) AND 'Ketoconazole' (use A-Z index to jump to K). Both should show checkmarks.
5. Tap 'Next' to see the Results.
6. Verify the Results page shows two interaction results - one for each co-medication pair with Crizotinib.
